headline_pain: Still Waiting for Stock? Act Now.
headline_outcome: Secure Your Warehouse Off the Plan
primary_text: "There's literally nothing available to buy in the size range we need in the west." Every month you wait, another business locks in a unit. Small-format industrial stock in Melbourne's west has a vacancy rate near zero. That's not changing. These off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina are among the only new small-format units coming to market. Princes Freeway access, West Gate Tunnel proximity, and 20km to the CBD. Once these are allocated, there's no more — and the next release will be at a higher price. Don't wait for stock that isn't coming.
description: Near-zero vacancy for small warehouses in the west — new Truganina units selling now.
